prompts.text: hi Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /tmp/al-267/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. An UPGRADE (e.g. Opus → Fable) needs Brett's approval: when you reach one, run `node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs request-upgrade <id> <phase>`, ask once, and stop. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch…
